why: A restart during sleep left the garage unlocked, but a naive catch-up would re-lock a deliberate unlock, so the regime persists an episode mark (operator option B) and vacation now relocks like sleep. Simpler guest onset thresholds were measured and were not faster; the October replay showed the stay ending on days guests were present, so only an exit day veto was added (19/21 days, 0 false). The HVAC evidence rule for other states had insufficient data, so shadow rows now measure it before any behaviour change. The Guest left button was stuck unavailable because buttons are not polled.
implications: Shipped GUEST-LEFT-BUTTON-READY-1, LOCK-BOOT-RECHECK-ENGAGE-1, HVAC-GUEST-EVIDENCE-RULE-1, GUEST-STAY-EXIT-DAY-VETO-1 at v5.108.5; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.5.md (Live criteria).
